verses.original: Περὶ δὲ ὧν ἐγράψατε καλὸν ἀνθρώπῳ γυναικὸς μὴ ἅπτεσθαι
verses.transliteration: Peri de hōn egrapsate kalon anthrōpō gynaikos mē haptesthai
verses.literal: Now for the matters you wrote about It is good to abstain from sexual relations . . .
verses.literalPt: ORA, quanto às coisas que me escrevestes, bom seria que o homem não tocasse em mulher;

verses.original: διὰ δὲ τὰς πορνείας ἕκαστος τὴν ἑαυτοῦ γυναῖκα ἐχέτω καὶ ἑκάστη τὸν ἴδιον ἄνδρα ἐχέτω
verses.transliteration: dia de tas porneias hekastos tēn heautou gynaika echetō kai hekastē ton idion andra echetō
verses.literal: But because there is so much sexual immorality each man should have his own wife and each woman her own husband
verses.literalPt: Mas, por causa da prostituição, cada um tenha a sua própria mulher, e cada uma tenha o seu próprio marido.

verses.original: Τῇ γυναικὶ ὁ ἀνὴρ τὴν ὀφειλὴν ἀποδιδότω ὁμοίως δὲ καὶ ἡ γυνὴ τῷ ἀνδρί
verses.transliteration: Tē gynaiki ho anēr tēn opheilēn apodidotō homoiōs de kai hē gynē tō andri
verses.literal: The husband should fulfill his marital duty to his wife and likewise . . . the wife to her husband
verses.literalPt: O marido pague à mulher a devida benevolência, e da mesma sorte a mulher ao marido.

verses.original: ἡ γυνὴ τοῦ ἰδίου σώματος οὐκ ἐξουσιάζει ἀλλὰ ὁ ἀνήρ ὁμοίως δὲ καὶ ὁ ἀνὴρ τοῦ ἰδίου σώματος οὐκ ἐξουσιάζει ἀλλὰ ἡ γυνή
verses.transliteration: hē gynē tou idiou sōmatos ouk exousiazei alla ho anēr homoiōs de kai ho anēr tou idiou sōmatos ouk exousiazei alla hē gynē
verses.literal: The wife does not have authority over her own body but the husband Likewise . . . the husband does not have authority over his own body but the wife
verses.literalPt: A mulher não tem poder sobre o seu próprio corpo, mas tem-no o marido; e também da mesma maneira o marido não tem poder sobre o seu próprio corpo, mas tem-no a mulher.

verses.original: Μὴ ἀποστερεῖτε ἀλλήλους εἰ μήτι ἂν ἐκ συμφώνου πρὸς καιρὸν ἵνα σχολάσητε τῇ προσευχῇ καὶ πάλιν ἐπὶ τὸ αὐτὸ ἦτε ἵνα μὴ πειράζῃ ὑμᾶς ὁ Σατανᾶς διὰ τὴν ἀκρασίαν ὑμῶν
verses.transliteration: Mē apostereite allēlous ei mēti an ek symphōnou pros kairon hina scholasēte tē proseuchē kai palin epi to auto ēte hina mē peirazē hymas ho Satanas dia tēn akrasian hymōn
verses.literal: Do not deprive each other except . . . . . . by mutual consent and for a time so you may devote yourselves to prayer Then come together - again so that Satan will not tempt you through your lack of self-control
verses.literalPt: Não vos priveis um ao outro, senão por consentimento mútuo por algum tempo, para vos aplicardes ao jejum e à oração; e depois ajuntai-vos outra vez, para que Satanás não vos tente pela vossa incontinência.

verses.original: τοῦτο δὲ λέγω κατὰ συνγνώμην οὐ κατ’ ἐπιταγήν
verses.transliteration: touto de legō kata syngnōmēn ou kat’ epitagēn
verses.literal: I say this as a concession not as a command
verses.literalPt: Digo, porém, isto como que por permissão e não por mandamento.

verses.original: θέλω δὲ πάντας ἀνθρώπους εἶναι ὡς καὶ ἐμαυτόν ἀλλὰ ἕκαστος ἴδιον ἔχει χάρισμα ἐκ Θεοῦ ὁ μὲν οὕτως ὁ δὲ οὕτως
verses.transliteration: thelō de pantas anthrōpous einai hōs kai emauton alla hekastos idion echei charisma ek Theou ho men houtōs ho de houtōs
verses.literal: I wish that all men were as I am But each man has his own gift from God one has this gift another has that
verses.literalPt: Porque quereria que todos os homens fossem como eu mesmo; mas cada um tem de Deus o seu próprio dom, um de uma maneira e outro de outra.

verses.original: Λέγω δὲ τοῖς ἀγάμοις καὶ ταῖς χήραις καλὸν αὐτοῖς ἐὰν μείνωσιν ὡς κἀγώ
verses.transliteration: Legō de tois agamois kai tais chērais kalon autois ean meinōsin hōs kagō
verses.literal: Now to the unmarried and widows I say this It is good for them to remain unmarried as I am
verses.literalPt: Digo, porém, aos solteiros e às viúvas, que lhes é bom se ficarem como eu.

verses.original: εἰ δὲ οὐκ ἐγκρατεύονται γαμησάτωσαν κρεῖττον γάρ ἐστιν γαμῆσαι ἢ πυροῦσθαι
verses.transliteration: ei de ouk enkrateuontai gamēsatōsan kreitton gar estin gamēsai ē pyrousthai
verses.literal: But if they cannot control themselves let them marry For it is better to marry than to burn with passion
verses.literalPt: Mas, se não podem conter-se, casem-se. Porque é melhor casar do que abrasar-se.

verses.original: Τοῖς δὲ γεγαμηκόσιν παραγγέλλω οὐκ ἐγὼ ἀλλὰ ὁ Κύριος γυναῖκα ἀπὸ ἀνδρὸς μὴ χωρισθῆναι
verses.transliteration: Tois de gegamēkosin parangellō ouk egō alla ho Kyrios gynaika apo andros mē chōristhēnai
verses.literal: To the married I give this command (not I but the Lord) A wife must not separate from her husband
verses.literalPt: Todavia, aos casados mando, não eu mas o Senhor, que a mulher não se aparte do marido.

verses.original: ἐὰν δὲ καὶ χωρισθῇ μενέτω ἄγαμος ἢ τῷ ἀνδρὶ καταλλαγήτω καὶ ἄνδρα γυναῖκα μὴ ἀφιέναι
verses.transliteration: ean de kai chōristhē menetō agamos ē tō andri katallagētō kai andra gynaika mē aphienai
verses.literal: But if she does she must remain unmarried or else be reconciled to her husband And a husband must not divorce his wife
verses.literalPt: Se, porém, se apartar, que fique sem casar, ou que se reconcilie com o marido; e que o marido não deixe a mulher.

verses.original: Τοῖς δὲ λοιποῖς λέγω ἐγώ οὐχ ὁ Κύριος εἴ τις ἀδελφὸς γυναῖκα ἔχει ἄπιστον καὶ αὕτη συνευδοκεῖ οἰκεῖν μετ’ αὐτοῦ μὴ ἀφιέτω αὐτήν
verses.transliteration: Tois de loipois legō egō ouch ho Kyrios ei tis adelphos gynaika echei apiston kai hautē syneudokei oikein met’ autou mē aphietō autēn
verses.literal: To the rest I say this (I, not the Lord) If a brother has an unbelieving wife and she is willing to live with him he must not divorce her
verses.literalPt: Mas aos outros digo eu, não o Senhor: Se algum irmão tem mulher descrente, e ela consente em habitar com ele, não a deixe.

verses.original: καὶ γυνὴ εἴ τις ἔχει ἄνδρα ἄπιστον καὶ οὗτος συνευδοκεῖ οἰκεῖν μετ’ αὐτῆς μὴ ἀφιέτω τὸν ἄνδρα
verses.transliteration: kai gynē ei tis echei andra apiston kai houtos syneudokei oikein met’ autēs mē aphietō ton andra
verses.literal: And if a woman has an unbelieving husband and he is willing to live with her she must not divorce him
verses.literalPt: E se alguma mulher tem marido descrente, e ele consente em habitar com ela, não o deixe.

verses.original: ἡγίασται γὰρ ὁ ἀνὴρ ὁ ἄπιστος ἐν τῇ γυναικί καὶ ἡγίασται ἡ γυνὴ ἡ ἄπιστος ἐν τῷ ἀδελφῷ ἐπεὶ ἄρα τὰ τέκνα ὑμῶν ἀκάθαρτά ἐστιν νῦν δὲ ἅγιά ἐστιν
verses.transliteration: hēgiastai gar ho anēr ho apistos en tē gynaiki kai hēgiastai hē gynē hē apistos en tō adelphō epei ara ta tekna hymōn akatharta estin nyn de hagia estin
verses.literal: For the unbelieving husband is sanctified through his believing wife and the unbelieving wife is sanctified through her believing husband Otherwise . . . your children would be unclean but now they are holy
verses.literalPt: Porque o marido descrente é santificado pela mulher; e a mulher descrente é santificada pelo marido; de outra sorte os vossos filhos seriam imundos; mas agora são santos.

verses.original: Εἰ δὲ ὁ ἄπιστος χωρίζεται χωριζέσθω οὐ δεδούλωται ὁ ἀδελφὸς ἢ ἡ ἀδελφὴ ἐν τοῖς τοιούτοις ἐν δὲ εἰρήνῃ κέκληκεν ὑμᾶς ὁ Θεός
verses.transliteration: Ei de ho apistos chōrizetai chōrizesthō ou dedoulōtai ho adelphos ē hē adelphē en tois toioutois en de eirēnē keklēken hymas ho Theos
verses.literal: But if the unbeliever leaves let him go The believing brother or sister is not bound in such cases - God has called you to live in peace
verses.literalPt: Mas, se o descrente se apartar, aparte-se; porque neste caso o irmão, ou irmã, não esta sujeito à servidão; mas Deus chamou-nos para a paz.

verses.original: τί γὰρ οἶδας γύναι εἰ τὸν ἄνδρα σώσεις ἢ τί οἶδας ἄνερ εἰ τὴν γυναῖκα σώσεις
verses.transliteration: ti gar oidas gynai ei ton andra sōseis ē ti oidas aner ei tēn gynaika sōseis
verses.literal: How do you know wife whether you will save your husband Or how do you know husband whether you will save your wife
verses.literalPt: Porque, de onde sabes, ó mulher, se salvarás teu marido? ou, de onde sabes, ó marido, se salvarás tua mulher?

verses.original: Εἰ μὴ ἑκάστῳ ὡς ἐμέρισεν ὁ Κύριος ἕκαστον ὡς κέκληκεν ὁ Θεός οὕτως περιπατείτω καὶ οὕτως ἐν ταῖς ἐκκλησίαις πάσαις διατάσσομαι
verses.transliteration: Ei mē hekastō hōs emerisen ho Kyrios hekaston hōs keklēken ho Theos houtōs peripateitō kai houtōs en tais ekklēsiais pasais diatassomai
verses.literal: Regardless . . . each one should lead the life that the Lord has assigned to him and to which God has called him This is what I prescribe in all the churches
verses.literalPt: E assim cada um ande como Deus lhe repartiu, cada um como o Senhor o chamou. É o que ordeno em todas as igrejas.

verses.original: περιτετμημένος τις ἐκλήθη μὴ ἐπισπάσθω ἐν ἀκροβυστίᾳ κέκληταί τις μὴ περιτεμνέσθω
verses.transliteration: peritetmēmenos tis eklēthē mē epispasthō en akrobystia keklētai tis mē peritemnesthō
verses.literal: Was a man already circumcised when he was called He should not become uncircumcised Was a man still uncircumcised when called He should not be circumcised
verses.literalPt: É alguém chamado, estando circuncidado? fique circuncidado. É alguém chamado estando incircuncidado? não se circuncide.

verses.original: ἡ περιτομὴ οὐδέν ἐστιν καὶ ἡ ἀκροβυστία οὐδέν ἐστιν ἀλλὰ τήρησις ἐντολῶν Θεοῦ
verses.transliteration: hē peritomē ouden estin kai hē akrobystia ouden estin alla tērēsis entolōn Theou
verses.literal: Circumcision is nothing and uncircumcision is nothing Keeping God’s commandments is what counts
verses.literalPt: A circuncisão é nada e a incircuncisão nada é, mas, sim, a observância dos mandamentos de Deus.

verses.original: Ἕκαστος ἐν τῇ κλήσει ᾗ ἐκλήθη ἐν ταύτῃ μενέτω
verses.transliteration: Hekastos en tē klēsei hē eklēthē en tautē menetō
verses.literal: Each one - should remain in the situation he was in when he was called
verses.literalPt: Cada um fique na vocação em que foi chamado.

verses.original: δοῦλος ἐκλήθης μή σοι μελέτω ἀλλ’ εἰ καὶ δύνασαι ἐλεύθερος γενέσθαι μᾶλλον χρῆσαι
verses.transliteration: doulos eklēthēs mē soi meletō all’ ei kai dynasai eleutheros genesthai mallon chrēsai
verses.literal: Were you a slave when you were called Do not let it concern you but if you can gain your freedom take the opportunity
verses.literalPt: Foste chamado sendo servo? não te dê cuidado; e, se ainda podes ser livre, aproveita a ocasião.

verses.original: ὁ γὰρ ἐν Κυρίῳ κληθεὶς δοῦλος ἀπελεύθερος Κυρίου ἐστίν ὁμοίως ὁ ἐλεύθερος κληθεὶς δοῦλός ἐστιν Χριστοῦ
verses.transliteration: ho gar en Kyriō klētheis doulos apeleutheros Kyriou estin homoiōs ho eleutheros klētheis doulos estin Christou
verses.literal: For he who was a slave when he was called by the Lord is the Lord’s freedman Conversely he who was a free man when he was called is Christ’s slave
verses.literalPt: Porque o que é chamado pelo Senhor, sendo servo, é liberto do Senhor; e da mesma maneira também o que é chamado sendo livre, servo é de Cristo.

verses.original: Τιμῆς ἠγοράσθητε μὴ γίνεσθε δοῦλοι ἀνθρώπων
verses.transliteration: Timēs ēgorasthēte mē ginesthe douloi anthrōpōn
verses.literal: You were bought at a price do not become slaves of men
verses.literalPt: Fostes comprados por bom preço; não vos façais servos dos homens.

verses.original: ἕκαστος ἐν ᾧ ἐκλήθη ἀδελφοί ἐν τούτῳ μενέτω παρὰ Θεῷ
verses.transliteration: hekastos en hō eklēthē adelphoi en toutō menetō para Theō
verses.literal: Brothers each one should remain in the situation he was in when God called him . . . . . .
verses.literalPt: Irmãos, cada um fique diante de Deus no estado em que foi chamado.

verses.original: Περὶ δὲ τῶν παρθένων ἐπιταγὴν Κυρίου οὐκ ἔχω γνώμην δὲ δίδωμι ὡς ἠλεημένος ὑπὸ Κυρίου πιστὸς εἶναι
verses.transliteration: Peri de tōn parthenōn epitagēn Kyriou ouk echō gnōmēn de didōmi hōs ēleēmenos hypo Kyriou pistos einai
verses.literal: Now about virgins I have no command from the Lord but I give a judgment as one who by the Lord’s mercy is trustworthy
verses.literalPt: Ora, quanto às virgens, não tenho mandamento do Senhor; dou, porém, o meu parecer, como quem tem alcançado misericórdia do Senhor para ser fiel.

verses.original: Νομίζω οὖν τοῦτο καλὸν ὑπάρχειν διὰ τὴν ἐνεστῶσαν ἀνάγκην ὅτι καλὸν ἀνθρώπῳ τὸ οὕτως εἶναι
verses.transliteration: Nomizō oun touto kalon hyparchein dia tēn enestōsan anankēn hoti kalon anthrōpō to houtōs einai
verses.literal: Because of the present crisis I think it is good - for a man to remain as he is
verses.literalPt: Tenho, pois, por bom, por causa da instante necessidade, que é bom para o homem o estar assim.

verses.original: δέδεσαι γυναικί μὴ ζήτει λύσιν λέλυσαι ἀπὸ γυναικός μὴ ζήτει γυναῖκα
verses.transliteration: dedesai gynaiki mē zētei lysin lelysai apo gynaikos mē zētei gynaika
verses.literal: Are you committed to a wife Do not seek to be released Are you free of commitment Do not look for a wife
verses.literalPt: Estás ligado à mulher? não busques separar-te. Estás livre de mulher? não busques mulher.

verses.original: ἐὰν δὲ καὶ γαμήσῃς οὐχ ἥμαρτες καὶ ἐὰν γήμῃ ἡ παρθένος οὐχ ἥμαρτεν θλῖψιν δὲ τῇ σαρκὶ ἕξουσιν οἱ τοιοῦτοι ἐγὼ δὲ ὑμῶν φείδομαι
verses.transliteration: ean de kai gamēsēs ouch hēmartes kai ean gēmē hē parthenos ouch hēmarten thlipsin de tē sarki hexousin hoi toioutoi egō de hymōn pheidomai
verses.literal: But if you do marry you have not sinned And if a virgin marries she has not sinned But those who marry will face troubles in this life and I want to spare you this
verses.literalPt: Mas, se te casares, não pecas; e, se a virgem se casar, não peca. Todavia os tais terão tribulações na carne, e eu quereria poupar-vos.

verses.original: Τοῦτο δέ φημι ἀδελφοί ὁ καιρὸς συνεσταλμένος ἐστίν τὸ λοιπὸν ἵνα καὶ οἱ ἔχοντες γυναῖκας ὡς μὴ ἔχοντες ὦσιν
verses.transliteration: Touto de phēmi adelphoi ho kairos synestalmenos estin to loipon hina kai hoi echontes gynaikas hōs mē echontes ōsin
verses.literal: What I am saying brothers is that the time is short From now on . . . . . . those who have wives should live as if they had none
verses.literalPt: Isto, porém, vos digo, irmãos, que o tempo se abrevia; o que resta é que também os que têm mulheres sejam como se não as tivessem;

verses.original: καὶ οἱ κλαίοντες ὡς μὴ κλαίοντες καὶ οἱ χαίροντες ὡς μὴ χαίροντες καὶ οἱ ἀγοράζοντες ὡς μὴ κατέχοντες
verses.transliteration: kai hoi klaiontes hōs mē klaiontes kai hoi chairontes hōs mē chairontes kai hoi agorazontes hōs mē katechontes
verses.literal: those who weep as if they did not those who are joyful as if they were not those who make a purchase as if they had nothing
verses.literalPt: E os que choram, como se não chorassem; e os que folgam, como se não folgassem; e os que compram, como se não possuíssem;

verses.original: καὶ οἱ χρώμενοι τὸν κόσμον ὡς μὴ καταχρώμενοι παράγει γὰρ τὸ σχῆμα τοῦ κόσμου τούτου
verses.transliteration: kai hoi chrōmenoi ton kosmon hōs mē katachrōmenoi paragei gar to schēma tou kosmou toutou
verses.literal: and those who use the things of this world as if not dependent on them For this world in its present form is passing away
verses.literalPt: E os que usam deste mundo, como se dele não abusassem, porque a aparência deste mundo passa.

verses.original: Θέλω δὲ ὑμᾶς ἀμερίμνους εἶναι ὁ ἄγαμος μεριμνᾷ τὰ τοῦ Κυρίου πῶς ἀρέσῃ τῷ Κυρίῳ
verses.transliteration: Thelō de hymas amerimnous einai ho agamos merimna ta tou Kyriou pōs aresē tō Kyriō
verses.literal: I want you to be free from concern The unmarried man is concerned about the work of the Lord how he can please the Lord
verses.literalPt: E bem quisera eu que estivésseis sem cuidado. O solteiro cuida das coisas do SENHOR, em como há de agradar ao Senhor;

verses.original: ὁ δὲ γαμήσας μεριμνᾷ τὰ τοῦ κόσμου πῶς ἀρέσῃ τῇ γυναικί
verses.transliteration: ho de gamēsas merimna ta tou kosmou pōs aresē tē gynaiki
verses.literal: But the married man is concerned about the affairs of this world how he can please his wife
verses.literalPt: Mas o que é casado cuida das coisas do mundo, em como há de agradar à mulher.

verses.original: καὶ μεμέρισται καὶ ἡ γυνὴ ἡ ἄγαμος καὶ ἡ παρθένος μεριμνᾷ τὰ τοῦ Κυρίου ἵνα ᾖ ἁγία καὶ τῷ σώματι καὶ τῷ πνεύματι ἡ δὲ γαμήσασα μεριμνᾷ τὰ τοῦ κόσμου πῶς ἀρέσῃ τῷ ἀνδρί
verses.transliteration: kai memeristai kai hē gynē hē agamos kai hē parthenos merimna ta tou Kyriou hina ē hagia kai tō sōmati kai tō pneumati hē de gamēsasa merimna ta tou kosmou pōs aresē tō andri
verses.literal: and his interests are divided The unmarried woman or virgin is concerned about the work of the Lord how she can be holy in both body and spirit But the married woman is concerned about the affairs of this world how she can please her husband
verses.literalPt: Há diferença entre a mulher casada e a virgem. A solteira cuida das coisas do Senhor para ser santa, tanto no corpo como no espírito; porém, a casada cuida das coisas do mundo, em como há de agradar ao marido.

verses.original: Τοῦτο δὲ πρὸς τὸ ὑμῶν αὐτῶν σύμφορον λέγω οὐχ ἵνα βρόχον ὑμῖν ἐπιβάλω ἀλλὰ πρὸς τὸ εὔσχημον καὶ εὐπάρεδρον τῷ Κυρίῳ ἀπερισπάστως
verses.transliteration: Touto de pros to hymōn autōn symphoron legō ouch hina brochon hymin epibalō alla pros to euschēmon kai euparedron tō Kyriō aperispastōs
verses.literal: I am saying this for your own good not to restrict . . . you but in order to promote proper decorum and undivided devotion to the Lord
verses.literalPt: E digo isto para proveito vosso; não para vos enlaçar, mas para o que é decente e conveniente, para vos unirdes ao Senhor sem distração alguma.

verses.original: Εἰ δέ τις ἀσχημονεῖν ἐπὶ τὴν παρθένον αὐτοῦ νομίζει ἐὰν ᾖ ὑπέρακμος καὶ οὕτως ὀφείλει γίνεσθαι ὃ θέλει ποιείτω οὐχ ἁμαρτάνει γαμείτωσαν
verses.transliteration: Ei de tis aschēmonein epi tēn parthenon autou nomizei ean ē hyperakmos kai houtōs opheilei ginesthai ho thelei poieitō ouch hamartanei gameitōsan
verses.literal: However if someone thinks he is acting inappropriately toward his betrothed and if she is beyond her youth and they ought to marry let him do as he wishes he is not sinning they should get married
verses.literalPt: Mas, se alguém julga que trata indignamente a sua virgem, se tiver passado a flor da idade, e se for necessário, que faça o tal o que quiser; não peca; casem-se.

verses.original: ὃς δὲ ἕστηκεν ἐν τῇ καρδίᾳ αὐτοῦ ἑδραῖος μὴ ἔχων ἀνάγκην ἐξουσίαν δὲ ἔχει περὶ τοῦ ἰδίου θελήματος καὶ τοῦτο κέκρικεν ἐν τῇ ἰδίᾳ καρδίᾳ τηρεῖν τὴν ἑαυτοῦ παρθένον καλῶς ποιήσει
verses.transliteration: hos de hestēken en tē kardia autou hedraios mē echōn anankēn exousian de echei peri tou idiou thelēmatos kai touto kekriken en tē idia kardia tērein tēn heautou parthenon kalōs poiēsei
verses.literal: But the man who is firmly established in his heart and under no constraint with control over his will and resolve in his heart not to marry the virgin he will do well
verses.literalPt: Todavia o que está firme em seu coração, não tendo necessidade, mas com poder sobre a sua própria vontade, se resolveu no seu coração guardar a sua virgem, faz bem.

verses.original: Ὥστε καὶ ὁ γαμίζων τὴν ἑαυτοῦ παρθένον καλῶς ποιεῖ καὶ ὁ μὴ γαμίζων κρεῖσσον ποιήσει
verses.transliteration: Hōste kai ho gamizōn tēn heautou parthenon kalōs poiei kai ho mē gamizōn kreisson poiēsei
verses.literal: So then . . . he who marries the virgin does well but he who does not marry her does even better
verses.literalPt: De sorte que, o que a dá em casamento faz bem; mas o que não a dá em casamento faz melhor.

verses.original: Γυνὴ δέδεται ἐφ’ ὅσον χρόνον ζῇ ὁ ἀνὴρ αὐτῆς ἐὰν δὲ κοιμηθῇ ὁ ἀνήρ ἐλευθέρα ἐστὶν ᾧ θέλει γαμηθῆναι μόνον ἐν Κυρίῳ
verses.transliteration: Gynē dedetai eph’ hoson chronon zē ho anēr autēs ean de koimēthē ho anēr eleuthera estin hō thelei gamēthēnai monon en Kyriō
verses.literal: A wife is bound to her husband as long as . . . he lives But if her husband dies she is free to marry anyone she wishes as long as he belongs to the Lord
verses.literalPt: A mulher casada está ligada pela lei todo o tempo que o seu marido vive; mas, se falecer o seu marido fica livre para casar com quem quiser, contanto que seja no Senhor.

verses.original: μακαριωτέρα δέ ἐστιν ἐὰν οὕτως μείνῃ κατὰ τὴν ἐμὴν γνώμην δοκῶ δὲ κἀγὼ Πνεῦμα Θεοῦ ἔχειν
verses.transliteration: makariōtera de estin ean houtōs meinē kata tēn emēn gnōmēn dokō de kagō Pneuma Theou echein
verses.literal: In my judgment however she is happier if she remains as she is And I think that I too have the Spirit of God
verses.literalPt: Será, porém, mais bem-aventurada se ficar assim, segundo o meu parecer, e também eu cuido que tenho o Espírito de Deus.
